automated_checks: structure: no unmatched tags, unique ids, title and description
leakage: no comments, internal paths, claim IDs, placeholders, withdrawn material or overstatement
files: the build holds exactly index.html, .nojekyll and the files the page uses
base path: every local link resolves inside /osu-lab/
external links: only planned Release downloads, repository, release page, site URL and upstream projects
assets: images and any video are approved assets with verbatim alt text, captions and attribution
video: approved playback attributes, muted inline autoplay, loop, controls and poster
downloads: versioned Release URLs; manifest, DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json, documents.json and files agree
identity: author, project, version, verbatim contribution statement
numbers: primary, secondary, design, arm means, throughput and conformance equal the records
qualifications: caveats beside the main result, D1 beside review acceptance, internal review
source: site/index.html is the source without preview-only blocks and comments
handoff integrity: registry, website handoff and checksums named by the manifest
claim map: basis and claim statuses match the current registry and manifest

browser.environment: Microsoft Edge (Chromium), Windows, fresh unauthenticated browser context per viewport/theme; Browser plugin unavailable, Playwright CLI used
